reading.body:
The Aligned Energy facility in Phoenix covers 200,000 square feet of technical space. No IT load figure in megawatts is published on the operator's spec page, so no power-based estimate of rack or accelerator count can be made from this data. Square footage alone does not determine AI relevance, because power density per square foot varies widely across facility designs and tenants.

The absence of a published megawatt figure places this campus outside the four Arizona facilities that have contributed to the state's mapped total of 512.02 MW. Arizona ranks among the states this site has read, with 56 mapped facilities of which only 4 publish a capacity figure. This campus ranks fifth by published megawatts in the state, which in practice means it is not yet ranked, because no megawatt figure has been published for it to rank against.

No certifications are listed in the published specifications, so no qualification statements can be made. Whether this campus is AI-relevant depends on power capacity and cooling density, neither of which Aligned Energy has published on the page this site read. A reader making a siting or investment decision would need the operator to disclose IT load, power delivery voltage, and cooling approach before this campus can be compared to the four Arizona facilities that have published those figures.
